messages:
Morgan: thinking about a tiny 'Neo-Retro LAN' this Friday around 7pm in the mezz — projector, mix of PC/console/Steam Decks. I can bring a Switch dock + HDMI cable :projector:
Elise: I can bring my Steam Deck (14) and a USB-C -> HDMI adapter, happy to host Rocket League :rocket:
Sam: have a PS5 controller and a handful of USB-C chargers. Also I have a long extension cord (25ft) :+1:
Ryan: last time the projector fan was loud, can we do optional headsets? I can bring two surge protectors and a couple of cheap earbuds.
Anna: poll idea — react with :one: for Smash, :two: for Rocket League, :three: for Risk of Rain 2. I vote :two:
Morgan: love it — also quick gear Q: who can bring Ethernet cables? We have flaky wifi when 10 people stream.
Elise: I have 2x 5m CAT6s. I'll bring them.
Sam: can someone volunteer to manage a tiny bracket for Smash? I'm terrible at organizing tournaments lol
Ryan: I can run a round-robin bracket, happy to help.
Anna: logistics — bring snacks? I'll grab chips + salsa. Any dietary prefs?
Morgan: great — @Elise can you add the event to the shared calendar?
CalendarBot: Event 'Neo-Retro LAN — Mezz' created for Fri 7:00PM by Morgan. Guests: Morgan, Elise, Sam, Ryan, Anna.
Sam: also reminder: label your chargers, last time people left them behind.
Elise: noted. I'll bring a small box for forgotten items.
Anna: i'm in for headphones if noise is an issue.
Morgan: perfect — final check: who can't make it? otherwise we'll lock in Friday.
Sam: in unless OOO pops up.
Ryan: same.
Elise: good to go.
Anna: yep. See y'all Friday! :game_die:
